title: When Is The Next Likely Good Deal on an M4 Max MacBook Pro, Apple Watch and AirPods? My Whole Bag Was Stolen
body:
Hi everyone,
Unfortunately, my bag was stolen while I was working alone at a kiosk. My MacBook Pro was inside, along with several other personal belongings, including my Apple Watch, AirPods and some cash.
I reported the incident to the police, but at this stage, I am not expecting to recover the laptop.
My previous laptop was a 14-inch MacBook Pro with an M2 Max chip, 32GB of unified memory and a 1TB SSD . I am a software engineering student and used it for development work, including running multiple applications, IDEs, virtual machines and more memory-intensive tasks such as ROS 2 and mapping projects.
I bought it in 2024 after the M4 models were released, so I managed to get it at a very good price. It was an excellent computer, and I had planned to continue using it for at least another five years.
I currently have an older laptop at home that I can use for general work. It should be enough to keep me going for now, so I do not necessarily need to buy a replacement immediately.
I have never bought an Apple Refurbished Mac before, so I am not sure whether that would be a good option. Among the brand-new models, I am currently considering an M4 Max MacBook Pro with at least 36GB or 48GB of unified memory and a 1TB SSD .
I noticed that JB Hi-Fi had a very good deal only a few days ago on the 16-inch M4 Max MacBook Pro with 36GB of unified memory in silver , but it has already sold out. The darker-coloured version is still available, but it remains at the original price.
I also noticed that the Apple Watch Series 11 was discounted recently. That would have been useful since my old Series 7 was stolen as well, but it has now returned to full price. It feels like I missed several good deals by only a few days.
Does anyone know when we are likely to see another genuinely good deal on the M4 Max models?
Would it be better to wait for:
Black Friday or Boxing Day sales?
Discounts after the next MacBook Pro generation is announced?
Apple Refurbished stock?
Clearance deals from JB Hi-Fi, Officeworks, Amazon or The Good Guys?
I would also appreciate any advice on what would be considered a genuinely good Australian price for an M4 Max configuration.
I am happy to wait a few months if a significant discount is likely.
Thanks in advance.
